items.distractor_fact: Судлаачийн зөөврийн дулаан хэмжигч мөн өглөө {D}°C заасан байв.
items.gloss_en: The researcher's portable thermometer also read {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: a researcher's portable thermometer (an instrument carried by a person), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a neighboring district's weather station, a place).

items.distractor_fact: Ус ашиглалтын компанийн хариуцдаг цөөрмийн усны түвшин {D} метр байдаг.
items.gloss_en: The water level of the reservoir managed by the water-utility company is {D} meters.
items.entity_note: a reservoir managed by a water-utility company (an organization), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a neighboring province's reservoir, a place).

items.distractor_fact: Өнгөрсөн жилийн бөмбөлгийн наадамд оролцсон бөмбөлгийн өндөр {D} метр байсан.
items.gloss_en: The altitude of the balloon that took part in last year's balloon festival was {D} meters.
items.entity_note: a balloon from last year's festival (a different series/year), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a different team's balloon, an organization).

items.distractor_fact: Нисэх компанийн бүртгэлийн хэмжуураар хэмжсэн өөр нэгэн ачаа {D} кг жинтэй гарчээ.
items.gloss_en: A different piece of luggage weighed by the airline's registration scale came out to {D} kg.
items.entity_note: luggage weighed by the airline's own scale (an organization's instrument), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a fellow traveler, a person).

items.distractor_fact: Статистикийн газарт бүртгэлтэй нүүдэлчдийн нэгдлийн хүн ам {D} хүн байдаг.
items.gloss_en: The population of a herders' cooperative registered with the statistics office is {D} people.
items.entity_note: a herders' cooperative registered with a government office (an organization), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a neighboring village, a place).

items.distractor_fact: Өнгөрсөн оны мөн тэр уралдаанд оролцсон гүйгчийн эхний хурд {D} км/ц байсан.
items.gloss_en: The starting speed of a runner who took part in last year's edition of the same race was {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: a runner from last year's edition of the race (a different series/year), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a different runner in the same race, a person).

items.distractor_fact: Өөр нэгэн дансны тооцоонд орсон энэ сарын орлого {D}₮ байв.
items.gloss_en: The income entered into a different bank account's statement this month was {D}₮.
items.entity_note: a different bank account's recorded income (a financial instrument/record), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a neighboring shop, a place-linked business).

items.distractor_fact: Тэр багийн улирлын өмнөх дасгал тоглолтуудад (нөхөрсөг тоглолт) оруулсан гол {D} байв.
items.gloss_en: That same team scored {D} goals in its preseason friendly matches.
items.entity_note: the same team's goals in preseason friendly matches (a different series/competition), differing in kind from the first sentence's owner (a different team, an organization).
